articles.title: Spider-Man's New Villain Was Almost the Shadow King Instead of Jean Grey
articles.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day almost featured the Shadow King, a creepy X-Men villain who possesses people. Marvel said no, so the writers used Jean Grey instead. The switch changed how the movie's mind control works.

articles.title: James Cook Creates Stunning Art Using Only a Typewriter
articles.summary: London artist James Cook makes detailed pictures using vintage typewriters. His Wimbledon tennis court artwork took over one million keystrokes. He owns more than 100 typewriters and sells his art for up to $40,000.

articles.title: Britain Defeats Ecuador 4-0 to Reach Davis Cup Final 8
articles.summary: Great Britain beat Ecuador 4-0 to reach the Davis Cup Finals for the first time since 2023. Henry Patten and Neal Skupski sealed the win in doubles, and Harry Wendelken won on his debut.
